title: Tesla launches six-seater Model Y variant in India
title_zh: 特斯拉在印度推出六座 Model Y 变体
summary: April 22 (Reuters) - U.S. electric-vehicle maker Tesla on Wednesday launched a six-seater version of its best-selling Model Y, priced at 6.2 million rupees ($66,324.35), the company's website showed.
summary_zh: 路透 4 月 22 日 - 美国电动汽车制造商特斯拉网站显示，该公司周三推出了其最畅销 Model Y 的六座版本，售价为 620 万卢比（66,324.35 美元）。

title: Stocks gain, dollar wobbles as Trump extends Iran ceasefire
title_zh: 特朗普延长伊朗停火协议，股市上涨，美元波动
summary: SINGAPORE, April 22 (Reuters) - U.S. stock futures rose and the dollar wavered on Wednesday after President Donald Trump said he would indefinitely extend the Iran ceasefire keeping sentiment buoyed
summary_zh: 路透新加坡4月22日 - 美国总统特朗普表示将无限期延长伊朗停火协议，提振市场情绪，周三美国股指期货上涨，美元波动

title: SpaceX Has Deal for Right to Acquire Cursor for $60 Billion
title_zh: SpaceX 已达成以 600 亿美元收购 Cursor 的权利
summary: (Bloomberg) -- SpaceX said it has an agreement giving it the right to acquire artificial intelligence startup Cursor for $60 billion later this year or to pay $10 billion for the companies’ work together, part of the Elon Musk-run firm’s efforts to catch up with rivals in AI c...
summary_zh: （彭博社）——SpaceX 表示，它已达成协议，有权在今年晚些时候以 600 亿美元收购人工智能初创公司 Cursor，或者为两家公司的合作支付 100 亿美元，这是埃隆·马斯克 (Elon Musk) 运营的公司在人工智能领域追赶竞争对手的努力的一部分。

title: Vodafone offers small businesses cybersecurity, AI capability with Google tie-up
title_zh: 沃达丰与谷歌合作为小型企业提供网络安全和人工智能功能
summary: European mobile and broadband operator Vodafone said it would offer its ‌small business customers advanced cybersecurity and agentic ‌AI through its $1 billion strategic tie-up with Google Cloud agreed in ​October 2024.
summary_zh: 欧洲移动和宽带运营商沃达丰表示，将通过 2024 年 10 月与谷歌云达成的价值 10 亿美元的战略合作关系，为其小型企业客户提供先进的网络安全和代理人工智能。

title: Tesla, Boeing, IBM, Southwest earnings: What to Watch
title_zh: 特斯拉、波音、IBM、西南航空公司的财报：值得关注的内容
summary: Asking for a Trend Host Josh Lipton previews several of the biggest stories to come tomorrow, Wednesday, April 22, including a torrent of earnings results from various companies that include GE Vernova (GEV), Boeing (BA), AT&T (T), Tesla (TSLA), International Business Mac...
summary_zh: 《寻求趋势》主持人乔希·利普顿 (Josh Lipton) 预览了明天（4 月 22 日星期三）即将发布的几个重大新闻，其中包括 GE Vernova (GEV)、波音 (BA)、AT&T (T)、特斯拉 (TSLA)、International Business Mac ...

title: Consumer watchdog group files suit alleging Meta profited on ads for scams
title_zh: 消费者监督组织提起诉讼，指控 Meta 通过诈骗广告获利
summary: The Consumer Federation of America has filed a class-action complaint against Meta Platforms alleging that the social-media giant has profited ‌from advertising for fraudulent activities on its platforms and misled users about ‌its efforts to combat the problem.
summary_zh: 美国消费者联合会已对 Meta Platforms 提起集体诉讼，指控这家社交媒体巨头通过其平台上的欺诈活动广告获利，并误导用户了解其解决这一问题的努力。

title: Meta breaks ground on over $1 billion data center in Oklahoma's Tulsa
title_zh: Meta 在俄克拉荷马州塔尔萨耗资超过 10 亿美元的数据中心破土动工
summary: April 21 (Reuters) - Meta Platforms said on Tuesday it has begun construction on a new data center in Tulsa, Oklahoma, a project valued at more than $1 billion, as the Facebook-parent races to build
summary_zh: 路透 4 月 21 日 - Meta Platforms 周二表示，已开始在俄克拉荷马州塔尔萨建设一个新数据中心，该项目价值超过 10 亿美元，Facebook 母公司正在竞相建设

title: Microsoft must face $2.8 billion UK lawsuit over cloud computing licences
title_zh: 微软必须在英国面临 28 亿美元云计算许可证诉讼
summary: LONDON, April 21 () - Microsoft must face a mass lawsuit alleging it overcharged thousands of British businesses to use Windows Server software on ‌cloud computing services provided by Amazon, Google and Alibaba, a London tribunal ‌ruled on Tuesday.
summary_zh: 伦敦，4 月 21 日 - 伦敦一家法庭周二裁定，微软必须面临大规模诉讼，指控其向数千家英国企业在亚马逊、谷歌和阿里巴巴提供的云计算服务上使用 Windows Server 软件收取过高费用。

title: What Apple's CEO shake-up suggests about its upcoming earnings
title_zh: 苹果首席执行官的变动对其即将发布的财报有何暗示
summary: Apple (AAPL) CEO Tim Cook is stepping down and will be replaced by John Ternus. Visible Alpha head of TMT research Melissa Otto and B. Riley Wealth chief market strategist Art Hogan break down what the CEO shake-up could indicate about the company's upcoming earnings results.
summary_zh: 苹果公司 (AAPL) 首席执行官蒂姆·库克 (Tim Cook) 辞职，由约翰·特努斯 (John Ternus) 接任。 Visible Alpha TMT 研究主管梅丽莎·奥托 (Melissa Otto) 和 B.
